title: Tab name pool contract
description: The pool the worker and the browser dialogs both draw new tab titles from. The name pattern keeps a title readable -- one capitalized word after the prefix -- and the 8-character cap keeps it short. It carries no other meaning: plan-mode auto-rename used to read a title back through this same pattern, and now reads the agents row's title_auto_generated instead. Rules the schema CANNOT express -- friendly form only, predictable pronunciation, distinct at a glance, no identity marker -- live in the contract's _rules field and are applied by a reviewer.
